name: Against the Odds
controllingIdea: Persistence and strategy can overcome seemingly impossible market conditions.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: Client faces a major obstacle - bidding war, limited inventory, credit issues, impossible timeline
narrativeArc.risingAction: Multiple setbacks increase stakes. Competition heats up. Doubts emerge.
narrativeArc.crisis: A moment of near-defeat. The 'all hope seems lost' turning point.
narrativeArc.climax: The breakthrough strategy or unexpected opportunity that changes everything.
narrativeArc.resolution: Victory achieved. Client in their new home. Relationship solidified.

triggerMoments.moment: Just won a multiple offer situation
Client with challenging circumstances got approved
Found inventory when there was nothing available

questions.question: What was the initial challenge or obstacle your client faced?
questions.purpose: Establish the inciting incident and stakes
questions.placeholder: They were competing against 12 other offers...

questions.question: What made this situation particularly difficult or competitive?
questions.placeholder: Cash buyers kept outbidding them, and inventory was at historic lows...

questions.question: What was the moment you thought it might not work out?
questions.placeholder: After losing the third house, they were ready to give up...

questions.question: What strategy or approach did you take to overcome it?
questions.purpose: Show the turning point and expertise
questions.placeholder: I suggested writing a personal letter and adjusting our offer structure...

questions.question: What was the outcome? How did it feel to win?
questions.purpose: Deliver the resolution and emotional payoff
questions.placeholder: We got the call that our offer was accepted, and my client burst into tears...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is an underdog victory story. The agent helped clients overcome significant obstacles. Emphasize the struggle, the strategy, and the triumph.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Triumphant but humble. Show the fight without bragging. Let the facts speak to the agent's expertise.

usageHints: Best used within a few days of the victory for authenticity
Include specific numbers (offer count, price, timeline) when possible
The 'crisis' moment makes the victory more impactful
Let the client's emotion show through

exampleScenarios.title: First-Time Buyers Beat Investors
exampleScenarios.situation: Young couple competing against all-cash investors in a hot market
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: My first-time buyers just beat out 8 cash offers! They had been searching for 6 months and lost 4 houses before this. We wrote a heartfelt letter and offered flexibility on closing date.

expectedOutput.hook: They lost 4 houses. Then beat 8 cash offers.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: A personal letter and flexible closing made all the difference.

exampleScenarios.title: Relocating Family Under Pressure
exampleScenarios.situation: Family needs to close in 3 weeks due to job start date
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: This family had exactly 3 weeks to find and close on a home before the husband started his new job. We toured 15 houses in 2 days and made an offer that night.

expectedOutput.hook: 3 weeks. 15 houses. One shot to get it right.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: Sometimes you have to move at the speed of life.
